The first error happened when the code tried to read the CSV file 'apple_stock_data.csv' and it wasn't found. The error message was a FileNotFoundError. So, the code couldn't find the file, which is a big issue because without the data, nothing else can be done.

FinancialData_Expert then tried to search for a direct download link but didn't find one, which led to the same problem. The code kept failing because the CSV wasn't there.
